before-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Do not think me rude outerlander, but our customs forbid me talking to you. All contact with outerlanders must be vetted by our chieftain, Brundt.
He is standing just over there. He will speak for the tribe.

after-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Hey! It's [Fremennik name]! Let me buy you a drink!
There ya go! Anyone who can drink like you earns my respect!
